claims.evidence: The photos show the item's appearance but do not confirm its origin or usage history.
Structural integrity and long-term reliability cannot be confirmed through static images.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the date stamp on the collar, shroud, or foot ring.
A video showing a soapy water test on the valve nozzle and stem.
A photo of the cylinder on a scale to compare actual weight against the stamped tare weight.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used/near end of life

risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the expiry date or manufacture date stamped on the metal.
Video of a soapy water leak test on the valve.
Photo of the cylinder on a scale to verify gas content and tare weight.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a 12.5kg Repsol gas cylinder. It can be priced at its worst-case value (empty and expired) until safety and content proofs are provided.
